levels.surface: موسى بن جعفر بن وهب البغدادي

notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» opens the report and prev1 writes its chain. prev1 runs to a different Imam and does not reach محمد بن مسعود, so no name can be taken over with confidence; the back reference is written as it stands. Check against prev1 before applying.
«قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الْبَاقِرِ» makes the Imam the last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
